subject: OmniBank DR: Temporary narrowing request for multi-region failover RTO/RPO
messages:
From: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@omnibank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@omnibank.com>, OmniBank SRE <sre@omnibank.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary narrowing of multi-region failover SLA for OmniBank POC

Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we prep for the internal risk review and budget sign-off, our compliance team is asking if we can temporarily narrow the multi-region failover obligations for the POC. Two concrete asks:

1) For non-US regions (APAC / LATAM) we would like the warm-standby RTO to be 60 minutes (instead of the standard 15–30).
2) For the same scope, allow an RPO up to 5 minutes for a 90‑day period while we validate cross-region replication and synthetic failover tests.

This is a hard constraint for the POC; OmniBank’s payment processing team cannot commit to full geo-redundant activation until after a month of test runs. We understand this is an exception to your standard SLA, and are open to paying for an operational addendum or a one-time fee.

I attached our short POC requirements doc (omnibank_poc_requirements.pdf). Can Redwood provide an outline of what a temporary amendment would look like, plus any operational commitments you would require (synthetic test cadence, monitoring, runbook signoff)?

Appreciate your help — if we can get a scoped amendment and evidence of monitoring in the next two weeks we can push the internal approval through.

— Alex
OmniBank — Head of Cloud Risk

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@omnibank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary narrowing of multi-region failover SLA for OmniBank POC

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the POC doc. We can support a temporary scope narrowing for a fixed window, but we need to align internal stakeholders on operational guardrails. At a high level here’s what we’d need from OmniBank to proceed:

- A signed 90‑day amendment specifying the regions and exact RTO/RPO values.
- Agreement to run weekly synthetic failover drills (we can provide the script).
- Access to an SRE contact for on-call coordination during any activation.
- Acceptance of an elevated monitoring surcharge for the period (covers retention and runbook staffing).

I’ve looped in Marissa to scope commercial terms and Kimberly to review runbook changes. Can you confirm which non‑US regions you want excluded from the normal 15–30 minute RTO (APAC only, APAC+LATAM, etc.) and whether OmniBank’s SRE team will accept a standard runbook signature?

If you’re ok we’ll:
1) Draft a redline amendment for signature.
2) Propose a monitoring/ops surcharge and acceptance tests.
3) Provide runbook appendix for your SRE to review.

We can aim for a draft by Thu (6/7) if we have the region list and SRE contact.

— Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@omnibank.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary narrowing of multi-region failover SLA for OmniBank POC

Alex / Camila —

Looping commercial context: for a 90‑day scoped relaxation we typically (a) require a one‑time operational amendment and (b) charge a small monthly ops fee to cover higher telemetry retention and staffed on-call coverage. Ballpark figures for OmniBank POC: $12k one‑time amendment processing + $3k/mo monitoring/ops surcharge. If you decide to drop APAC only (vs APAC+LATAM) we can reduce pricing by ~25%.

Camila, attaching a proposed amendment redline (proposed_amendment_redline.docx). It captures: exact RTO/RPO values, test cadence, acceptance criteria and the surcharge.

Alex — please confirm:
- Do you want APAC only or APAC+LATAM excluded from the standard 15–30 minute RTO?
- Who is the SRE contact that will sign the runbook appendix?

If OmniBank agrees to APAC‑only and the fees above we can package the amendment + DocuSign and have Legal expedite.

— Marissa
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@omnibank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary narrowing of multi-region failover SLA for OmniBank POC

Alex —

Thanks for the detail. Operational feasibility notes from Product/Oncall:

- We can accept a 90‑day, region‑scoped RTO of 60 minutes with an RPO of 5 minutes for APAC only, provided OmniBank agrees to:
  * Run weekly synthetic failover drills (Redwood provides scripts and a Canary harness).
  * A 48‑hour notice window before any planned standby activation during the POC.
  * A signed runbook appendix acknowledging responsibilities for prefix cache priming and cross‑region KV sync validation.

- Required acceptance tests (we will run these jointly):
  1) Simulated cold cutover for a single shard (max 45 minutes to restore production traffic).
  2) Verification of KV cache priming (samples and success criteria).
  3) Cross‑region log consistency check (within 5 minutes).

- Fee model: agree with Marissa’s outline; monitoring surcharge enables 30‑day log retention for the POC window.

If OmniBank confirms APAC only and provides SRE contact (name + email) we will:
1) Post a redline to DocuSign by EOD tomorrow (link below).
2) Publish the runbook appendix to the shared Drive.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/prepare/omnibank-amendment-5682
Runbook draft: https://drive.redwood.com/omnibank/POC/specs
